content.label: Examiner note - rust needs two guests, and three ways to stop it
content.body: Iron rusts only when air (oxygen) AND water are both present - name both or lose the mark. Prevention is a three-way menu: barrier methods (paint, oil, grease), galvanising (a zinc coat that also protects sacrificially), and sacrificial protection (a more reactive metal, such as zinc or magnesium blocks, corrodes in the iron's place). Say which reactant the sacrificial metal protects, not just 'it rusts less'.
